question: Submission description (a short paragraph)
answer: Reference-free Gemini 3.6-Flash with reasoning enabled, set to medium. The null task2_pred scores are imputed using the mean score of the same MT system across all non-null segments in the same language pair, falling back to that system's global mean across all pairs, and finally to the dataset-wide mean if no non-null scores exist for that system.
